import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap

INK = ''#252525''
CMAP_DIV = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
    ''gw_r'',
    [''#525252'', ''#bdbdbd'', ''#ffffff'', ''#fb6a4a'', ''#99000d'']
)

RAW_COLS = [''TongTaiSan'',''TongDoanhThu'',''TongNoPhaiTra'',''EBITDA'',''LoiNhuanRong'']
RAW_LABELS = [''Tổng tài sản'',''Tổng doanh thu'',''Tổng nợ phải trả'',''EBITDA'',''Lợi nhuận ròng'']

cm = dataset[RAW_COLS].corr(method=''pearson'')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5.5))
n = len(RAW_COLS)
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(cm.values, dtype=bool))
data = np.ma.array(cm.values, mask=mask)

im = ax.imshow(data, cmap=CMAP_DIV, vmin=-1, vmax=1, aspect=''auto'')

# Ghi số trong ô
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i):
        v = cm.values[i, j]
        ax.text(j, i, f''{v:.2f}''.replace(''.'', '',''),
                ha=''center'', va=''center'', fontsize=10,
                color=''white'' if abs(v) > 0.6 else INK)

ax.set_xticks(range(n))
ax.set_xticklabels(RAW_LABELS, rotation=40, ha=''right'', fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(n))
ax.set_yticklabels(RAW_LABELS, fontsize=9)
ax.tick_params(length=0)
for s in ax.spines.values():
    s.set_visible(False)
# Colorbar
cb = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, shrink=0.75, pad=0.03)
cb.outline.set_visible(False)
cb.set_label(''Hệ số tương quan'', fontsize=9)
cb.ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()'
